note: Assumed per-node durations. No n8n recording exists yet; every value here is a stated assumption, not a measurement. M1 replaces this table with one derived from the raw execution export, and the run files' labels change with it.

schedulerOverheadMs.basis: assumed: n8n executor bookkeeping between consecutive nodes

Lead Webhook (form / ad).basis: assumed: in-process receipt of a small JSON POST, responded onReceived

Normalize Lead.basis: assumed: Code node sandbox spin-up plus ~40 lines of JavaScript

Enrichment (placeholder — disabled).basis: disabled in workflow.json: n8n passes data through without executing

GHL: Upsert Contact.basis: assumed: one HTTPS round trip to services.leadconnectorhq.com from a self-hosted instance

GHL: Send Instant SMS.basis: assumed: one HTTPS round trip; the API queues the message and returns before carrier delivery

GHL: Send Branded Email.basis: assumed: one HTTPS round trip with a larger body

Log to Google Sheets.basis: assumed: OAuth token check plus values.append; the slowest call in the chain

Wait 15 Minutes.basis: workflow parameter (15 minutes); the engine reads the parameter, not this entry

GHL: Check for Reply.basis: assumed: one HTTPS GET round trip

replyCheckTimeoutMs.basis: assumed: the base workflow sets no explicit timeout on the HTTP Request node, so the node default applies; the default's exact value is unverified until the M1 capture
